milestones.name: Defeat The Last Embedders
milestones.note: Hardest optional boss; unlocks 'Shame On You' trophy

milestones.name: Defeat Twisted Baron
milestones.note: Requires all 6 Fragmented Serial Numbers; unlocks 'Washing Machine' trophy

zones.name: Metropolis
zones.fingerprintHint: Main city hub zone; connects to Dwellings and contains hidden hole on stairs

zones.name: Dwellings
zones.fingerprintHint: Region connecting Metropolis to the area above Metropolis; traversal zone

zones.name: Area above Metropolis
zones.fingerprintHint: Optional area accessible via Dwellings; arena containing The Last Embedders

zones.name: Vaults
zones.fingerprintHint: Contains large room with drawer, pumps, and pipe drop; location of Dr Halyn's Collector and Mel

zones.name: Manufactory
zones.fingerprintHint: End of area contains Twisted Baron; requires 6 Fragmented Serial Numbers to access boss

zones.name: Canopy
zones.fingerprintHint: Contains The Friends :) boss; requires Friends Invitation from room to the right to open door at bottom of drop

abilities.name: Hairpin Grapple
abilities.note: Recommended for use against all optional bosses in this segment

abilities.name: Allocation Matrix
abilities.note: Should be optimized for combat before boss encounters

abilities.name: Corrupted Boss Mode
abilities.grants: Bosses weaken after each death (Assist menu option)
abilities.note: Optional accessibility/assist feature recommended when struggling

abilities.name: Fragmented Serial Numbers
abilities.grants: Access to Twisted Baron boss fight
abilities.note: All 6 must be collected to access Twisted Baron

abilities.name: Friends Invitation
abilities.grants: Access to The Friends :) boss fight
abilities.note: Found in room to the right in the Canopy area; used to open door at bottom of drop

abilities.name: Coating Components
abilities.note: Recommended to collect before fighting The Last Embedders

abilities.name: Mod Extensions
abilities.note: Recommended to collect before fighting The Last Embedders

bosses.name: The Last Embedders
bosses.note: Hardest optional boss in the game; trophy: Shame On You. Demands strong dodge timing and high damage output.

bosses.name: Dr Halyn's Collector
bosses.note: Optional boss; defeating it saves Mel. Reached via drawer in large room, activating pumps, and jumping down pipe. Trophy: Rescued.

bosses.name: Twisted Baron
bosses.note: Optional boss at end of Manufactory; requires all 6 Fragmented Serial Numbers to access. Trophy: Washing Machine.

bosses.name: Dr Halyn's Experiment #223
bosses.note: Optional boss; found by dropping down hidden hole on stairs. Trophy: Maybe Knock Next Time?

bosses.name: The Friends :)
bosses.note: Optional boss; requires Friends Invitation from room to the right, then opening door at bottom of drop. Trophy: A Web Of Lies.
